toolkitPackage.name: @camerontaylor/cq-toolkit
toolkitPackage.source: selected local checkout at the immutable toolkitCommit; packaged with scripts/pack-toolkit.sh

packageContent.treeAlgorithm: sha256(relative-path NUL file-sha256 LF; paths sorted by en locale)

workflowCorpus.split: all six scenarios are visible calibration; no held-out task or oracle is included
workflowCorpus.heldoutReservation: whole template and fault-family identities reserved before tuning in the corpus manifest; reservation metadata does not enforce a read boundary
workflowCorpus.redGreenAndAdequacyEvidence: test/campaign-workflows.test.ts; six synthetic red/green oracle pairs plus six local/mocked exported-operation integrations; not role-task adequacy evidence
workflowCorpus.coverageLimit: operation-level integrations exercise selected exported APIs; they do not claim full end-to-end coverage of review-loop, runPrs, sweep cleanup/salvage, test-fix execution, analysis apply/verification/restoration, or model-role scoring
workflowCorpus.pristineBaselineIntegrity: synthetic task vectors are versioned by this manifest and SHA256; no toolkit or existing substrate fixture changed

scope.stage: S0 bounded dependency reconciliation plus bounded visible S5 workflow corpus slice
